api: buildHeldReport({journalRoot,fixtureRoot,expectedIndexSha,attemptId?}) -> canonical bytes + sha256; read-only; never unlocks, repairs, resets consumption, invokes transport or grants authority

changes.HR-1: Accept PLAN then NATIVE_RECEIPT without RAW only when the journal-bound native receipt strictly parses with rawFile.sha exactly WRITE_FAILED and a warnings array containing LOCAL_RAW_RETENTION_FAILED, with no prior RELEASE_REQUEST; raw role NOT_RETAINED_WRITE_FAILED; issue RAW_NOT_RETAINED. All other native-without-raw sequences remain UNSUPPORTED_SEQUENCE.
changes.HR-2: TERMINAL disposition RELEASE on the target with lock PRESENT and no owner mismatch adds RELEASE_RECORDED_LOCK_RETAINED.
changes.HR-3: Any validated attempt with CLAIM_INTENT and no NATIVE_RECEIPT adds OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_AFTER_CLAIM.

independent.diffReview: No change beyond HR-1/2/3 and schema string

findings.detail: If a raw file exists but no RAW row was journaled and the native receipt says WRITE_FAILED (reachable if the RAW event write fails after the raw file write), RAW_NOT_RETAINED fires while the raw role stays UNBOUND with CROSSFILE_INVALID; consistency stays INCOMPLETE. The flag and the raw role come from separate code paths.

HR-3 applies to every validated history attempt, not only the target; HR-1 acceptance applies to the target only, so a non-target raw-failure attempt still reports invalid history. Multi-attempt histories were not tested.

limits: TEST_ONLY synthetic fixtures; no operational reconciliation, unlock or authority.
v11 remains accepted and frozen; v12 is a separate accepted read-only revision.
next: Local EM2 controller and report track has no further unrun item from the handoff; remaining EM2 work is owner-gated measurement preparation.
